item.title: Network Performance Testing Tool iperf
item.description: 1. Installation Ubuntu 1 apt-get install -y iperf3 CentOS 1 yum install -y iperf3 2. Parameters The principle behind iperf3 is that the client sends packets to the server so the network can be analyzed. It has two running modes: client and server. The iperf3 parameters fall into three groups: common parameters, client parameters, and server parameters.
